name: SSH Authorized Keys File Alteration
description: Detects addition or modification of SSH authorized_keys file on Linux or macOS endpoints.
explanation: Backdooring SSH authorized_keys grants an adversary persistent, passwordless interactive access to the host.
investigation_steps: Inspect the authorized_keys file to determine the new public key identity/comment.
Check recent SSH network connections to identify inbound logins.
Audit active user sessions and recent sudo command executions.
